mia: Quick sync — final checklist for Wed 11:00 UTC webinar. Reg page live? HubSpot mapping done?

mike: Reg page is live on /events/benchmarks, CTA and GDPR checkbox tested. Form fields mapped to HS: email, first_name, company, role, consent. I pasted the embed snippet in the doc.

mike: ```<iframe src="https://forms.hubspot.com/embed/abc123"></iframe>```

kevin: Zoom setup notes: cloud recording = ON (record gallery + shared screen), auto-join registrants = disabled, alternate host = @zuri. Enable 'recording transcript' and set cloud folder to Redwood/Events/2026-05-benchmark. Also enable original audio files.

zuri: I uploaded the target folder and set perms for marketing+ops. Also toggled "Enable live streaming" in Zoom for RTMP fallback. Saved the stream key in 1Password path: /secrets/zoom/webinar-2026-bench.

mia: For post-event: plan is auto-send replay email at +48h, include 30s highlight, transcript link, and CTA to benchmark whitepaper. Tag leads with "webinar-bench-2026" and set owner for hot leads.

mike: HubSpot workflow: trigger on form submission + attendance >= 5min -> wait 48h -> send replay email + add tag + assign owner to SDR queue. Draft email saved at HS > Marketing > Drafts > Webinar Replay. Audience suppression: already added internal-exclude list.

kevin: Quick backup plan if cloud recording fails: RTMP fallback streams to Vimeo (account vimeo@redwood). I added an ffmpeg command to ops runbook to capture fallback: ```ffmpeg -i rtmp://zoom/fallback -c copy output.mp4```

ops-bot: [notice] Zoom meeting 987-654-321 scheduled for 2026-05-12T11:00:00Z. Cloud recording: enabled. Auto-transcription: enabled. Live streaming (RTMP): enabled. Asset path: Redwood/Events/2026-05-benchmark.

zuri: Ownership: edits/transcript cleanup = @mike, clip + highlight creation = @kevin, analytics + funnel check = @mia. Please confirm.

mia: confirmed. small ask — can we include a 30s clip demonstrating the benchmark throughput chart in the replay email? need clip by EOD Tuesday.

mike: can do. Will pull 30s, add caption, upload to HubSpot assets by Tue 17:00 UTC. :thumbsup:

mia: thanks team, that should cover it. I'll post final checklist to the handbook and ping all when preflight is green. :rocket:
